feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated for it. (1) Iteration 1 (entityR2B) shows the oval finishes 20 of 20 with max_error 0.025 m, while s-bend finishes 8 of 20 and slalom fails in all 20 at progress 0.18 with about 2 line-loss events. The failure is drift off the tape, not jitter, so sensor reach is the lever to test. (2) To keep the controller's steering gain per metre of offset, I had to raise kp from 2.0 to 3.0 when the array widened, because the weights sit at x/0.02 m rather than x/0.012 m. Any further widening will need another kp rescale, so please keep weights proportional to x. (3) Iteration 1 used a 0.05 m forward offset. We have no evidence yet on whether 0.065 m helps, so this is still untested. Change rules for the next race: if slalom progress rises above 0.18 but line_loss_events on slalom stays at 1 or more, widen the array further with 7 sensors at x = +/-0.06, +/-0.04, +/-0.02, 0 m (20 mm spacing). If the oval's steering_oscillation rises above about 0.4 while finishing rates hold, narrow back toward x = +/-0.032 m to reduce gain. If the s-bend still fails at about progress 0.83 with low oscillation, move sensors forward to y = 0.065 m to see sharp bends sooner.
requested_changes: Try the 0.08 m array (x = +/-0.04 m, 20 mm spacing, 16 mm footprints) as proposed, since iteration 1 showed slalom and s-bend fail from drift while the oval finishes; if slalom still shows line-loss events, widen to 7 sensors at x = +/-0.06, +/-0.04, +/-0.02, 0 m.

If steering_oscillation rises above about 0.4 on the oval while finishing rates hold, reduce the outer sensor x to +/-0.032 m, since iteration 1 showed oscillation of 0.25 on the oval and any kp rescale raises jitter.
If s-bend still fails near progress 0.83 with low oscillation, try sensor y = 0.065 m, since iteration 1 showed lag is untested and the earlier look-ahead could help the sharp bends.
